digest.component_or_area: dependency advisory gating and response workflow
propositions: A committed lock file freezes transitive dependencies, causing any published advisory against a pinned version to immediately fail the gating pip-audit job across all in-flight changes regardless of whether those changes touch the dependency map

The Gerrit verify lane must block on a CRITICAL/HIGH advisory only when the change touches dependency declarations (uv.lock, pyproject.toml, poetry.lock, requirements/constraints files), and must not block on advisories for dependency-untouching changes

The scheduled main lane must fail visibly and route to an owner when a CRITICAL/HIGH advisory is outstanding, blocking releases but not merges, with automatic ticket filing and dedup following the bridge-canary pattern

override-dependencies is the correct instrument for patching an upstream cap (not constraint-dependencies which can only narrow and returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected output, and not uv lock --upgrade-package which is a no-op against caps), and must carry a REMOVE-WHEN condition with justification
Severity defaults to HIGH for unrated advisories (CRITICAL/HIGH fail, MEDIUM warns, LOW tracked) and is enriched from OSV metadata with fail-soft enrichment to keep the gate strict during outages

The runbook must document the verification set (uv lock --check, uv sync --locked --extra dev, pip-audit over whole environment) and pre-empt false-progress moves (recheck cannot clear real findings, constraint-dependencies returns UNSATISFIABLE as expected not as proof).
